item.title: Marks2Games meets Jindřich Cestovatel
item.description:
Our good friend Jindřich, the creator behind the travel channel Jindřich Cestovatel, filmed a short interview with us.

We’re happy to share it with you — watch the interview on YouTube and explore his channel for more travel videos.
